purpose: Follow-up hypothesis: useful-related grade 1 is a positive for similar-issue retrieval; strict duplicate-only training left most query families unused
method: Same frozen E5 bilinear residual and same fixed ridge settings as strict-only probe; only training supervision coverage changes
training: All explicit grade 1/2 > grade 0 comparisons with neither label low-confidence; equal anchor weight; grade 1 never a negative
validation: Leave connected issue component out, including original proposals and all reviewed edges
comparison: Production hybrid versus same hybrid with adapted dense scores
go_no_go: Mean known R@10 improves, no component loses R@10, mean R@100 does not fall, held-out preference accuracy improves; research signal only
no_tuning: One fixed setting, no alpha/margin sweep. Report this as a sequential exploratory experiment after strict-only failure, not independent confirmation.
